title: Andy Hall's article supporting the chemical-plant hypothesis
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Andy Hall's article supporting the chemical-plant hypothesis, about 2020s at Thunderbolts Project, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he wrote a huge not a paper but a post on his website um basically an article um uh exposing the virtues of my work and corroborating why they are chemical manufacturing facilities that are powered by Earth's electricity.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm argues that the ancient pyramids were chemical factories powered by the Earth's own electricity. On Jesse Michels's podcast, Drumm says that a man named Andy Hall, connected with the Thunderbolts Project, a group that studies the role of electricity in nature and space, wrote a long article on his website in the 2020s praising Drumm's work and backing up his idea. Drumm tells it as support from an outside voice for his view of what the pyramids were for.
